title: A Sharp Wigner–Husimi Inequality for Phase-Invariant Bosonic States
description: We establish the sharp Wigner–Husimi inequality conjectured by C. N. Gagatsos (arXiv:2611.30969) for every phase-invariant single-mode bosonic state, including arbitrary countable Fock mixtures without an energy cutoff. The proof uses Laguerre fourth moments, a gamma-ratio comparison, and a countable mixture argument. At finite Husimi square-root integral, equality holds precisely for the vacuum in this sector; displacement covariance extends the mathematical result to displaced phase-invariant states. The archive includes the manuscript and Lean 4 formalization of the explicit planar series inequality, strict comparison and convergence. The physical operator identification and displacement covariance are supplied by the manuscript rather than formalized. This is a partial result on Open Quantum Problem F19; the general conjecture remains open. The work was developed with AI assistance and has not yet undergone independent mathematical or journal peer review.
